title: 69 Forest Hills, Rathcoole, Co. Dublin
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present this impressive four-bedroom semi-detached family home to the market, ideally located within the ever-popular and highly sought-after Forest Hills development in the heart of Rathcoole, Co. Dublin.

 

No. 69 Forest Hills offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation throughout, having been thoughtfully extended to the rear. Generous accommodation of c.109 sqm comprises a welcoming entrance hallway, spacious living room, a well-appointed kitchen/dining area, spacious downstairs bedroom & ensuite. Upstairs is home to three generously proportioned bedrooms and a main family bathroom.

 

One of the standout features of this fine home is its large north-facing rear garden, offering an excellent private outdoor space with ample room for family use, entertaining, or further potential. The property also benefits from rear access, with ample parking available to the rear, making this an especially practical feature for any growing family.

 

Forest Hills enjoys an enviable location just moments from Rathcoole's vibrant Main Street, where every conceivable amenity is within easy reach. A fantastic selection of schools, shops, cafés, restaurants, and local services are all within walking distance, while Rathcoole Park is just a short stroll away. The area is exceptionally well served by Dublin Bus, offering convenient access to Dublin City Centre, and the nearby N7 and M50 provide excellent connectivity to the wider Dublin area. A wide range of sporting and recreational facilities are also close at hand.

 

Offering generous accommodation, a rear extension, excellent outdoor space, and an enviable location, No. 69 Forest Hills is sure to appeal to growing families and those looking for a spacious home in the heart of Rathcoole.

 

Early viewing is highly recommended. Contact RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS today to arrange your viewing.

 

Features
• 4 bed, 2 bath
• Semi-detached
• Extended to the rear
• Large north-facing rear garden
• Rear access
• Ample parking available to the rear
• Generous and well-proportioned accommodation
• Ideally located in the heart of Rathcoole Village
• Highly sought after location
• An abundance of amenities and transport links on your doorstep
• Early viewing is highly advised
